parameters.description_en:
The ID of the edge instance. You can obtain this ID by hovering your mouse over the target edge instance name on the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to retrieve it.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。

> You can specify up to 20 device IDs in a single invocation.
